k.v: कपर्दोऽस्य जटाजूटः पिनाकोऽजगवं धनुः। प्रमथा: स्युः पारिषदा ब्राह्मी इत्याद्यास्तु मातरः। ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा। वारीही च तथेन्द्राणी चामुण्डा सप्तमातरः॥
पुलोमजा शचीन्द्राणी नगरी त्वमरावती। हय उच्चैःश्रवाः सूतो मातलिर्नन्दनं वनम्.।

(for etym. as given by native authorities See Nir. x, 8; Sāy. on RV. i, 3, 4; Uṇ. ii, 28; according to BRD. fr. इन् = √ इन्व् with suff. र preceded by inserted द्, meaning ‘to subdue, conquer’ ; according to Muir, S. T. v, 119, for सिन्द्र fr. √ स्यन्द्, ‘to drop’; more probably from √ इन्द्, ‘to drop’ q.v., and connected with इन्दु above), the god of the atmosphere and sky

the Indian Jupiter Pluvius or lord of rain (who in Vedic mythology reigns over the deities of the intermediate region or atmosphere; he fights against and conquers with his thunder-bolt [वज्र] the demons of darkness, and is in general a symbol of generous heroism; इन्द्र was not originally lord of the gods of the sky, but his deeds were most useful to mankind, and he was therefore addressed in prayers and hymns more than any other deity, and ultimately superseded the more lofty and spiritual Varuṇa; in the later mythology इन्द्र is subordinated to the triad Brahman, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, but remained the chief of all other deities in the popular mind), RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; Mn.; MBh.; R. &c. &c.
(he is also regent of the east quarter, and considered one of the twelve Ādityas), Mn.; R.; Suśr. &c.
in the Vedānta he is identified with the supreme being
a prince
ifc. best, excellent, the first, the chief (of any class of objects; cf. सुरेन्द्र, राजेन्द्र, पर्वतेन्द्र, &c.), Mn.; Hit.
the pupil of the right eye (that of the left being called Indrāṇī or Indra's wife), ŚBr.; BṛĀrUp.
the number fourteen, Sūryas.

of a physician

punastamulUkamabravIdrAjarziH । aTAsti kaScidBavataH sakASAccirajAta iti sa evamukto'vravIdasti KalvindradyumnaM nAma sarastasminnAqIjaNGo nAma vakaH prativasati so'smattaScirajAtatarastaM pfcCeti । tata indradyumno mAYcolUkamAdAya tatsaro'gacCadyatrAsO nAqIjaNGo nAma vako baBUva । so'smABiH pfzwo BavAnimamindradyumnaM rAjAnamaBijAnAti sa enaM muhUrttaM DyAtvA'bravInnABijAnAmyahamindradyumnaM rAjAnamiti tataH so'smABiH pfzwaH kaScidBavato'nyaScirajAtataro'stIti sa no'bravIdasti Kalvasminneva sarasyakUparo nAma kacCapaH prativasati sa mattaScirajAtataraH sa yadi kaTaYcidaBijAnIyAdimaM rAjAnaM tamakUpAraM pfcCaDvamiti । tataH sa vakastamakUpAraM kacCapaM vijYApayAmAsaM । astyasmAkamaBipretaM BavantaM kaYcidarTamaBiprazwuM sADvAgamyatAM tAvaditi tacCrutvA kacCapastasmAt sarasaH utyAyAByagacCadyatra tizWAmo vayaM tasya sarasastIre AgataYcEnaM vayamapfcCAma BavAnimamindradyumnaM rAjAnamaBijAnAtIti । sa muhUrttaM DyAtvA vAzpasampUrRanayana udvignahfdayo vepamAno visaMjYakalpaH prAYjalirabravIt । kaTamahamenaM na pratyaBijYAsyAmIha hyanena sahasrakftvaScitizu yUpA AhitAH । saraScedamasya dakziRABirddattABirgoBiratikramamARABiH kftam । atra cAhaM prativasAmIti । aTEtan sakalaM kacCapenodAhftaM SrutvA tadanantaraM devalokAddevaraTaH prAdurAsIrAdvAcaScASrUyanta indradyumnaM prati prastutaste svargo yaTocitaM sTAnaM pratipadyasva kIrttimAnasyavyagro yAhIti” । etatsaraScoktavAkye varRitaM taccADikftya । “indradyumnasaraH prApya haMsakUwamatAtya ca । SataSfNgaM mahArAja tApasaH mamatapyata” ityukteH SataSfNgaparvvatasamIpe haMsakUwAnantaraM tatsaraH iti gamyate । “haMsakUwasya yacCfNgamindradyumnasaraH prati” iti harivaM॰ 157 ukteSca haMsakUwasannikfzwatvamasyAvagamyate । puruzottamamUrttiprakASakaScAparaH puruzottamaSabde tadvivftirvakzyate ।

s: klI, (indrARAmindriyARAM jAlaM Avarakam । yadvA indrasya parameSvarasya jAlaM mAyA iva .) mAyAkarmma । BojavAji, Belki ityAdi BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । kuhakaM 2 jAlaM 3 kusftiH 4 । tadvivaraRagranTo yaTA, -- “aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi cendrajAlamanuttamam । vyADidAridraharaRaM jarAmftyuvinASanam ॥ indrasya yo na jAnAti jAleSaM rudraBAzitam । nigrahAnugrahe tasya kA SaktiH parameSvari ! ॥ na tezAM jAyate sidDirgotre kzetre gfhe'pi vA । indrajAlaM na jAnAti sa krudDaH kiM karizyati ॥ na jIvati varArohe saMsAre duHKasAgare । indrajAlaM na jAnAti kutaH sOKyaM BavettataH ॥ kOtUhalaM kutastezAM kutaH kAmA varAnane ! । saMsArasAgare Gore kAmalubDASca mAnavAH । rudrakarmma na hi tezAM kutaH sOKyaM viDIyate ॥ yaTA nadOnadAH sarvve sAgare samupAgatAH । taTA sarvvARi SAstrARi indrajAlasTitAni ca ॥ taptAnAYca yaTA BAnuH SItalAnAM yaTA SaSo । gamBIrARAM yaTA simDurjAlendraYca taTA priye ! । taTA kiM bahunoktena varRanena punaH punaH । jAlendrasya samaM SAstraM na BUtaM na Bavizyati” ॥ * ॥ “aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi ozaDInAM viDiM vare । yena vijYAnamAtreRa sarvvasidDirBavizyati ॥ mahAkAlasya vIjAni prasTamekaM samAharet । DAtrIrasena deveSi ! sapta vArAn viBAvayet” ॥ guwikA karttavyA tAM guwikAM muKe nikzipya pArAvato Bavati ॥ 1 ॥ “aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi SfRu tvaM mama vallaBe । CAgasya SIrzaM saMgfhya kfzRamfttikAM pUrayitvA punarDustUravIjAni vApayet kAle tAni puzpitAni Bavanti tadA yasyopari nikzipet sa CAgo Bavati ॥ 2 ॥ mayUraSIrzamAdAya kfzRacaturdaSyAM mfttikAM pUrayet SaRavIjAni vApayet yadA Palito puzpito Bavati tadA SaRavIjAni grIvAyAM banDayet tena mayUro Bavet ॥ 3 ॥ kfzRacaturdaSyAM mayUraSIrzamAdAya kfzRamfttikAM pUrayet kArpAsavIjAni vApayet yadA PalitAH puzpitA Bavanti puzpaPale saMgfhya samastaM pezayitvA aNgaM vilipya pAnIyamaDye praviSya taTA jale tizWet yaTA sTale ॥ 4 ॥ kfzRa-kAka-SIrzamAdAya kAkamAcIvIjAni vApayet yadA PalitAH puzpitA Bavanti tatPalaM saMgfhya muKe prakzipya kAko Bavati kAka iva gacCati mahyA udgIrRe mokzaH ॥ 5 ॥ pArAvataSIrzamAdAya kfzRamfttikAM pUrayitvA tilavIjAni vApayet kzIrodakena siYcanIyaM yadA puzpitA Bavanti tadA muKe saMsTApya antarhito Bavet ॥ 6 ॥ tezAM PalAnAM cUrRaM kftvA tena cUrRena yaM spfSati sa kiNkaro Bavet sarvvasvaM dadAti ॥ 7 ॥ tAni tilAni saMgfhya netrAYjanena saha pizwvA kapilAdugDena guwikAM kArayet । saptarAtraM pAcayet । tAM guwikAM muKe nikzipya antarhito Bavati devErapi na dfSyate manuzyARAM kA kaTA । udgIrRena puruzo Bavati । jIvedvarzaSataM striyaH sarvve janASca vaSyA Bavanti ॥ 8 ॥ gfDraSiraH samAdAya kfzRacaturdaSyAM kfzRamfttikAM nikzepet laSunavIjAni vApayet yadA PalaM puzpaM Bavati tadA puzyanakzatre puzpaM gfhItvA aYjanena saha kapilAGftena kajjalaM pAtayet cakzuraYjanIyaM tAvat yojanaSataM paSyati medinIM divA nakzatrARyapi paSyati lABastasya । kiYcit karttumicCati tat karoti na saMSayaH ॥ 9 ॥ anye ca sarvve jIvAH evaM uzwragadDaBamahizyAdilaGuvfhajjIvAH । yat yat vIjaM yasya Sirasi vApayet yadA puzpitaH Palito Bavati tadA yasya vIjAni muKe nikzipyante sa jIvo Bavati nAtra sandehaH ॥ 10 ॥ * ॥ aTa sarvvezAM DAraRamantraH । o~ hrIM hrIM hreM EM laM laM o~ BO svAhA । ekAdaSAkzaro manurasya puraScaraRaM lakzajapaH । daSAMSahomaH Gftena tarpaRaM mArjanaM brAhmaRaBojanAdikaM kArayitvA sidDirBavati ॥ * ॥ aTa vaSyADikAraH । “mAtuluNgasya mUlantu DustUravIjakena ca । palARqupuzpamAdAya sUkzmacUrRant kArayet ॥ yo'sya ganDaM samAGrAti sa ca snehena paSyati । dunduBiM pawahAMScEva SaNKAMScEva tu lepayet ॥ eza BUtopasfzwAnAM kumArIRAM gfhezu ca । BfpateH sevyamAnAnAM taTApatyApajIvinAM ॥ na cAgnirdahyate veSma yatrEza so'gado Bavet” । atra mantraH । o~ “raktacAmuRqe amukaM me vaSamAnaya hrI~ hrIM hUM Paw । ayutaM japtavyam । o~ namo'stu AdityAya kili kili cili cili DUmaM lihi yakziRi modate hi SAkini anidudruSUlapARi svAhA ॥ varRAH 40 SilAkftike mantre । o~ namo guhAvAsinyE guhapati guhile manojavo o~ eM o~ vijve namaH । SilAyAH kftiH karaliKitA KadirAnalasantaptaliNgA yato navayozito'pi AkarzaRaM । varRAH 26 । o~ namaH kapAlarudrAya sarvvalokavaSaNkarAya anATAyApratihatabalavIryyaparAkramapraBavAya hA hA he he paca paca mAraya mAraya kapawa kapawa kAwa sarpa karmmakari amukaM me vaSamAnaya svAhA । 77 । varRAH ayutajapAdvaSIkaroti ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “pArAvatasya hfdayaM cakzurjihvA ca SoRitam । aYjanaM rocanayutaM vanitAvaSakft param” ॥ tatra mantraH । o~ naya naya mahAriRi namo devyE svAhA ॥ 15 ॥ ekaviMSativArAn parijapya sidDirBavati ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “kapAlaM mAnuzaM gfhyaM kanakasya PalAni ca । karpUraM maDusaMyuktaM niGfzya tilakena ca ॥ nArI vA puruzo'nena vaSyo Bavati nityaSaH । eza kApAliko yogo vaSizWasya SuBaMmatam” ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । puruzArTI । “karpUraM vAlukaM lAkzA rajasA saptaBAvitaM । ratikAle BagaM lipya patirdAso Bavizyati” ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “narajihvAM mamudDftya sUhmacUrRantu kArayet । jalena ca suSItena dApayet tadvicakzaRaH ॥ pAne Pale ca puzpe ca Bakzye Bojye ca dApayet । prajApatikulodBUtA yadi sAkzAdarunDatI ॥ sABisaktA priyaM yAti nAnyaM puruzamicCati” ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “kanakaYcApyapAmArgaM surasA gOrasarzapAH । tilatElena pizwvApi yonilepaH praSasyate” ॥ atra mantraH । o~ nama SayyAyE dari vidari yAmini amukaM me vaSamAnaya svAhA ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । haritAlaM SmaSAne kfzRacaturdaSyAM kziptvA kuzWavimiSraM grAhyaM avaSyaM vaSI Bavet sa naraH ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । ftunavalocanatAlAlalAwAsTibARasADitaM tElaM sakalamanujendralalanAvaSaNkaraM makarAlaye puzye । naratElaM pretAmbaravarktikaM kftvA mAtre rAtrO prajvAlyArkavfkzaskanDe kajjalaM kftvA cakzuzI aByaYjayet yaMpaSyati sa vaSyo Bavati ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “karRadantamalaM lAlA svadehAkzimalatrayam । nAsikodBavaraktaYca cUrRametadbalAyutam ॥ etat sarvvaM samudDftya guwikAM kArayedbuDaH । pAnaBojanake deyA vaSIkaraRamuttamam” ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । kAkajihvA vacA kuzWaM Atmano ruDiraM striyaH । tadBAvitaYca maYjizWA tagaraM gOrasarzapAH ॥ SivanirmAlyasaMyuktaM samaBAgAni kArayet । Bojye pAne'TavA deyAH strIRAntu vaSakArakAH ॥ nityaM puruzamicCantI mftamapyanugacCati ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । kfzRasarpamapyaNgulapramARaM SiraSCitvAsyAsyaM sarzapAdiBiH pUrayitvA CAyASuzkaM Sozayet । parataH sarzapAn grAhayitvA tAni yasmE dIyate sa vaSyo Bavati ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH ॥ pUgIPalaM nirgilitvApAnamArga nirgataM gfhyaDustUrarasAntaritaM kftvA saptadinAni pUjayet ॥ punaH kuNkumacandanEraDiBAvya yasmE dIyate sa vaSyo Bavati ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “dardurayugmaM gfhItvA tadDUmena dAhayet । tadBasma saha pAnena vaSyakft paramo mataH” ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “ajaganDasya patrARi vacA kuzWena mAvayet । SmaSAnaBasmasaMyuktaM cUrRaYcettrizu durlaBam ॥ anenEva tu cUrRena jowayet triSca pAdapam । puzpitaM PalitaM dfzwvA cUrRaM vfkzAdvilagnayet । tatkzaRAt Palate vfkzo naranArIzu kA kaTA ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “jihvAmUle saptarAtraM sEnDavenApi miSritam । dadAti yasya pAnezu so'pi vaSyo Bavet kzaRAt” ॥ * anyaprakAraH । “gopittaM sEnDavaYcEva vfhatIPalameva ca । lepametat prayoktavyaM naranArIvaSaNkaram” ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “bAlAmUlaM cUrRayitvA raktaretaHsamanvitaH । dadyAt pAnena pramadAM kziprameva vaSaM nayet ॥ puttrAdiYca DanaM tyaktvA dAsIvat Bavati tu sA । yatra vA nIyate tatra paScAt Bramati vihvalA” ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । valmIkamfttikAyAH pratikftiM kftvA kzIreRa snApya Ajyena vA aByajya tasya lavaRAhutimekaviMSativAraM juhuyAt trirAtreRa vaSyo Bavati saptarAtreRATavA । devIYca gAnDArIM yakziRIM SakrasyApi patnIM vaSamAnayati ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “udgAtuH pakziRo malamAtmano ruDirAnvitam । strIpuMsayoH pradAtavyaM vaSIkaraRamuttamam” ॥ atra mantraH । triSUline trinetrAya hili hili svAhA । varRAH 14 । saptajaptena sidDiH ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “kfzRapakzacaturdaSyAM mftaBasma tu grAhayet । strIRAYca mUrdDni dAtavyaM vidyayA parijaptayA ॥ dahyate muhyate nArI pacyate Suzyate'pi ca । aNgAni cEva Bajyante yadi taM na samAviSet” ॥ atra mantraH । o~ namaScAmuRqe SmaSAnavAsini svAhA । varRAH । 14 । saptarAtreRa prerakaH ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “SvetArkaM rocanAyuktaM AtmamUtreRa pezayet । lalAwe tilakaM kftvA trElokyaM kzoBayet kzaRAt । dfzwamAtreRa tenEva sarvvo Bavati kiNkaraH” ॥ * ॥ anyaprakAraH । “SvetArkaM candanenEva ramayet saha lepayet । dIyate kasyacidvApi paScAddAsI Bavizyati ॥ * ॥ aTa pativaSIkaraRam । “maDukaM saha tElena sArzapeRa tu pezayet । etena pARimaByajya BartrA sA sahitA svapet ॥ saMvftte mETunIBAve patirdAso Bavizyati” ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “manaHSilAkuNkumasarzapASca taTA ca kuzWaM sahadevadAru । raktaYca raktaM palitena sArdDam prapezayet sUkzmataraM mahAntam ॥ prasnAtapUrvvABimuKo'pi BUtvA saMsmftya lakzmIYcarukeRa pUjya । tataH prakuryyAt tilakaM lalAwe vAmAcca hastAccaturaNgulIBiH ॥ puMdfzwamAtreRa Bavet sa kAntAdAsAtidAsaSca kimatra citram” ॥ * ॥ aTa liNgalepADikAraH । “vfhatIPalamUlAni pippalI maricAni ca । BayA rocanayA sArdDaM liNgalepottamo mataH ॥ niHSezastrIjagatkarzaM nAmnA strIhfdayANkuSam । mohanaM SastrametadDi madanasya smftaM buDEH” ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “kuzWaYca DAtakIpuzpaM maricAni vacA taTA । anena liNgamAlipya kftsnAM SyAmAM vaSaM nayet ॥ tAsAYcittaharo'pyeza mftamapyanugacCati । vivaSA BaktiBAvena paScAt sarvvaM prayacCati” ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “paYcaraktAni saMgfhya SuBAni ca yaTecCayA । sarvvARi samaBAgAni priyaNguYcApi tatsamam ॥ nAgaraM daSaBAgena lepaH kAntAvaSaNkaraH” ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “devadAru vacA kuzWaM caturTaM vESvaBezajaM । AmlavIjarasEryuktaM gOrISyAmAvaSaNkaram” ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “haridrA vfhatImUlaM BadramustaM taTotpalam । viqaNgaM kfzRaM vEraYca samaBAgAni kArayet ॥ liNgalepottamo hyeza raktavallIvaSaNkaraH” ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “haridrA pippalImUlaM padmaM maDukameva ca । etAni samaBAgAni navanItena pezayet ॥ liNgalepottamo hyeza gOrIprItAya SANkaraH” ॥ * ॥ “kOSikaSoRitalepAt secanAdvApuzwaM BavelliNgaM । tadvaSantejastamBamayaM kIlakasadfSaM Bavecca ॥ kOSikaM ruDiraM gfhya gomUtreRa ca pezayet । vIryyaM hi stamBayennityaM praharArdDaM na saMSayaH” ॥ * ॥ sarvvasADAraRo mantraH । o~ eM hrIM hrIM SrIM Paw svAhA । anena mantreRa sarvvayogAnaBimantrya sidDiH” । iti SrIpArbbatIputtraSrInityanATaviracite sidDaKaRqe tantrasAre kOtUhalavidyAnAma indrajAlatantram ॥ * ॥ pustakatrayamAlocya yaTAsADyaM SoDitametat ॥ * ॥ * ॥ apica । ISvara uvAca । “indrajAlaM vinA rakzAM na karotIti niScitam । rakzAmantraM mahAmantraM sarvvasidDipradAyakam” ॥ “oM namo nArAyaRAya viSvamBarAya indrajAlakOtukAni darSaya darSaya sidDiM kuru kuru svAhA” azwottaraSatajapena sidDiH ॥ * ॥ aTa rakzAmantraH । “oM namaH parabrahmaparAtmane mama SarIre pAhi pAhi kuru kuru” ॥ “ullukasya kapAlena GftenAhatakajjalaM । tena netrAYjanaM kftvA rAtrO paWati pustakam ॥ 1 ॥ aNkolavIjanikzipte guruvAre muKe gaje । mantreRa siYcayennityaM yAvadvIjaPalaM ha vE ॥ trilOhavezwitaM kftvA ekavIjaM muKe sTitam । mattamAtaNgavIryyastu vAyutulyaparAkramaH ॥ daSahemadvizawtAmraM zoqaSaM rUpyaBAgakam । evaM saMKyA trilohI ca jYAtavyA sarvvakarmmaRi ॥ 2 ॥ yAni kAni ca vIjAni jaNgamaM sTalameva ca । aNkolavIjanikzipte muKe BUmitale Druvam ॥ tadvIjaM muKamaDyasTaM trilohErvezwitaM kuru । tadrUpo hi Bavenmarttyo nAnyaTA SaNkaroditam ॥ 3 ॥ yAni kAni ca vIjAni ca । indrajAlaYca dravyaviSezasaMyogena adDutavastudarSakavyApAraH (kimazwari) iti saMlaRqaBAzA prasidDaH mantradravyaviSezeRa vastuno'nyaTA karaRavva । taccadattAtreyatantre mantraviSezasADyam vistaraRABihitam । indrajAlatanye tu ozaDiviSe Ra taTAcaraRaM yaduktaM tatodiNmAtraM pradarSyate । “aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi cendrajAlamanuttamam” ityupakramya “aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi ozaDInAM viDiM vare! yena vijYAnamAtreRa sarvvasidDirBavizyati । mahAkAlasya vIjAni prasTamekaMsamAharet । DAtrIrasena deveSi! sapta vArAn viBAvayeta । karttavyA guwikA tAM ta svenikzipya pArvvati! acireREva kAlena svayaM pArAvato Bavet । aTAtaH saMpravakzyAmi SfRa tvaM mama vallaBe! । CAgasya SIrzaM saNgfhya tatra kfzRamfttiva rayitka pubarDastaravIgani vApayet yatkAle tAni puzpitAni Bavanti tadA yasyopAra nikzipet sa CAgo Bavati । mayUraSIrzamAdAyakfzRacaturdaSyAM mfttikAM pUrayet SaRavIjAni vApayet yadA PalitaH puzpito Bavati tadA SaRavIjAni grIMvAyAM banDayet mayUro Bavati । kfzRacaturdaSyAM mayUraSIrzamAdAya kfzRamfttikAM pUrayet kArpAsavIjAni vApayet tadA PalitAH puzpitA Bavanti puzpaPale saMgfhya samastaM pezayitvA aNgaM vilipya pAnIyamaDye praviSya yadA jale tizWati tadA mayUro Bavati । kfzRakAkaSIrzamAdAya kAkamAcIvIjAni vApayet yadA PalitA puzpitA Bavati tatPalaM saMgfhya muKe prakzipya kAko Bavati । kAka iva gacCati mahyAmudgIrRe mokzaH । pAravataSIrzamAdAya kfzRamfttikAM pUrayitvA tilavIjAni vApayet kzIrodakena secanIyaM yadA puzpito Bavati tadA muKe saMsTApya antarhito Bavati । tezAM PalAnAM cUrRaM kftvA tena cUrRena yaM spfSati sa kiNkaro Bavati । sarvvasvaM dadAti । tAni tilAni saMgfhya netrAYjanena saha pizwvA kapilAdugDena guwikAM kArayet saptarAtraM pAcayet tAM guwikAM muKe nikzipya antarhito Bavati devErapi na dfSyate manuzyARAM kA kaTA । udgIrRe puruzo Bavati । jIvedvarzaSataM striyaH sarve janASca vaSyA Bavanti । gfDraSiraH samAdAya kfzRacaturdaSyAM kfzRamfttikAyAM nikzipet laSunavIjAni vApayet yadA PalaM puzpaM Bavati tadA puzyanakzatre puzpaM gfhItvA aYjanena saha kapilAGftena kajjalaM pAtayet cakzuraYjanIyaM yAvat tAvat yojanaSataM paSyati medinyAM, divA nakzatrARyapi paSyati । evaM uzwragarddaBamahizAdInAM vfhajjIvAnAM Sirasi yat yatvIjaM yasya Sirami vApayet yadA puzpitaH Palito Bavati tadA yasya vIjAni muKe nikzipyante sa jIvo Bavati nAtra sandehaH । mAtulaNgasya mUlantu DustUravIjakena ca । palARqu puzpamAdAya sUkzmacUrRantu kArayet । yo'sya ganDaM samAGrAti sa ca snehena paSyati । dunduBiM pawahAMScEva SaNKAMScEva tu lepayet । eza BUtopasfzwAnAM kumArIRAM gfhezu ca । BUpatiM sevamAnAnAM taTA tatkarmmajIvinAm । na cAgnirdahyate veSma yatrEza so'gado Bavet । pArAvatasya hfdayaM cakzurjihvA ca SoRitam । aYjanaM rocanAyugmaM vanitAvaSakft param । kapAlaM mAnuzaM gfhya kanakasya PalAni ca । karpUraM maDusaMyuktaM niGfyya tilakena ca । nArI vA puruzo'nena vaSyo Bavati nityaSaH । eza kApAliko yogo vaSizWasya SuBaM matam । narajihvAM samudDftya sUkzmacUrRantu kArayet । jalena ca suSItena dApayettadvicakzaRaH । pAne Pale ca puzpe ca Bakzye Bojye ca dApayet । prajApatikulodBUtA yadi sAkzAdarunDatI sApi raktA priyaM yAti nAnyaM puruzamicCati । haritAlaM SmaSAne kfzRacaturdaSyAM kziptvA kuzWavimiSraM grAhyam avaSyaM vaSIBavet sa naraH । naratElaM pretAmbaravarttikaM kftvA pAtrerAtrO prajvAlyArkavfkzaskanDe kajjvalaM kftvA cakzuzI aByaYjet yaM paSyati sa vaSyo Bavati । karRadantamalaM lAlA svadehAkzimalatrayam । nAsikodBavaraktaYca cUrRametadvalAyutam । etat sarvaM samudDftya guwikAM kArayedbuDaH । pAnaBojanake deyaM vaSIkaraRamuttamam । kAkajihvA vacA kuzWamAtmano ruDiraM striyaH । tadBAttadannaM kaYjizWA tagaraM gOrasarzapAH । SivanirmAlyasaMyuktaM samaBAgAni kArayet । Bojye pAne'TavA deyaM strIRAntu vaSakArakam । nityaM puruzamicCantImftamapyanugacCati । kfzRasarpasyANgulapramARaM SiraSCittvAsyAsyaM sarzapAdiBiH । pUrayitvA CAyASuzakaM Sozayet । parataH sarzapAn grAhayitvA tAni yasmE dIyate sa baSyo Bavati । pUgIPalaM gilitvA'pAnamArgeRa nirgataM saMgfhya DustUrarasAntaritaM kftvA sapta dinAni pUjayet । punaH kuNkumacandanEraDivAsya yasmE dIyate sa vaSyo Bavati । dardurayugmaM gfhItvA tadDUmena dAhayet । tadBasma saha pAnena vaSyakft paramo mataH । ajaganDasya pattrARi vacAM kuzWena BAvayet । SmaSAnaBasmasaMyuktaM cUrRaYcettrizu durlaBam । anenEva ta cUrRena yojayet trIMSca pAdapAn । puzpitaM PalitaM dfzwvA cUrRaM vfkzAdvilagnayet । tat kzaRAt Palate vfkzo naranArozu kA kaTA । jihvAmUle saptarAtraM sEnDavenApi miSritam । dadAti yasya pAnezu so'pi vaSyo Bavet kzaRAt । gopitaM sEnDavaYcEva vfhatIPalameva ca । lepyametat prayoktavyaM naranArIvaSaNkaram । udgAtuH pakzamalina Atmano ruDirAnvitam । strIpuMsayoH pradAtavyaM vaSIkaraRamuttamam । SvetArkaM rocanAyuktamAtmamUtreRa pezayet । lalAwe tilakaM kftvA trElokyaM kzoBayet kzaRAt । dfzwamAtreRa tenEva sarvo Bavati kiNkaraH । SvetArkaM candanenEva raYjayet saha lepayet । dIyate kasya cidvApi paScAt dAso Bavizyati । maDUkaM saha tElena sArzapeRa tu pezayet । etena pARimaByajya BartrA sA sahitA svapet । saMvftte sETunIBAve patirdAso Bavizyati” । “yAni kAni ca vIjAnyaNkolatElena melayet । saPalo jAyate vfkzaH sidDiyoga udAhftaH । SavamuKe vindumAtraM tattElaM niHkziped yadi । ekayAmaM Bavet jIvo nAnyaTA SaNkaroditam । SigruvIjasTitaM tElaM pArAvata purIzakam । varAhasya vasAyuktaM gfhItvA ca samaM samam । gardaBasya vasAyuktaM haritAlaM manaHSilAm । eBistu tilakaM kftvA yaTA laNkeSvaronfpaH । ulluvizwAM gfhItvA tveraRqatElena pezayet । yasyANge nikzipet vindu sakzipto jAyate Druvam । sarpadantaM gfhItvA tu kfzRavfScikakaRwakam । kfkalAraktasaMyuktaM sUkzmacUrRantu kArayet । yasyANge nikzipeccUrRaM sadyo yAti yamAlayam । sindUraM ganDakaM tAlaM samaM pizwvA manaHSilAm । talliptavastraM Sirasi agnivat dfSyate Gruvam । arkakzIraM vawakzIraM kzIraM qumbarasamBavam । gfhItvA pAtrake lipte jalapUrRaM karoti ca । dugDaM tatra Bavet sadyo mahAkOtukakOtukam । aNkolatElaliptANgo dfSyate rAkzasAkftiH । palAyante narAH sarve paSupakzigajA hayAH । aNkolasya tu tElena dIpaM prajvAlayennaraH । rAtrO paSyati BUtAni KecarARi mahItale । buDe vA SanivAre vA kfkalAM grAhya yatnataH । SatrurmUtrayate yatra kfkalAM tatra niHkzipet । niKanedBUmimaDyezu udDfte ca punaH suKI । napuMsakaMBavet satyaM nAnyaTA SaNkaroditam । ganDakaM haritAlaYca gomUtraYca vizaM taTA । sUkzmacUrRamayaM kftvA kiYcidvahniM viniHkzipet । viGnAH sarvve palAyante yaTA yudDezu kAtarAH” dattAtreya tantre 11 pa॰

jalam । tatra cAdAya kalasErnecCantyanyajjalaM janAH । kuvindA na ca santyatra na cAtra paSyatoharAH । celAnyalaNkftAnyatra yataH kalpadrumArpaRAt । gaRakA nAtra vidyante cintAvidyAviSAradAH । yataSCinatti sarvezAM cintAM cintAmaRirdrutam । sUpakArA na santyatra rasapAkavicakzaRAH । dugDe sarvarasAnekA kAmaDenurato'niSam । kIrttiruccEHSravAyasya sarvato vAjirAjizu । ratnamuccEHSravAH so'tra hayAnAM pOruzADikaH । ErAvato dantivaraScatudento'tra rAjate । dvitIya iva kElAsojaNgamaH sPawikojjvalaH । taruratnaM pArijAtaH strIratnaM corvaSI tviha । nandanaM vanaratnaM ca ratnaM mandAkinI hyapAm । trayastriMSat surARAM yA kowiH SrutisamIritA । pratIkzate sAvasaraM sevAyE pratyahaM tviha । svargezvindrapadAdanyanna viSizyeta kiYcana । yadyattri lokyAmeSvaryyaM na ca tulyamanena hi । aSvameDasahasrasya laByaM vinimayena yat । kintena tulyamanyat syAt pavitramaTavA mahat । arccismatI saMyamanI puRyavatyanilAvatI । ganDavatyalakESI ca nEtattulyA mahardDiBiH । ayameva sahasrAkzastvayameva divaspatiH । SatamanyurayaM devonAmAnyetAni nAmataH । saptApi lokapAlA ye taenaM samupAsate । nAradAdyErmunivarErayamASIrBirijyate । etatsTEryyeRa sarvezAM lokAnAM sTEryyamizyate । parAjayAnmahendrasya rtralokyaM syAt parAjitam । danujA manujAdEtyAstapasyantyu grasaMyamAH । ganDarvayakzarakzAMsi mAhendrapadalipsavaH । sagarAdyAmahIpAlAvAjimeDaviDAyakAH । kftavanto mahAyatnaM SakrESvaryyajiGfkzavaH । nizpratyUhaM kratuSataM yaH kaScit kurute'vanO । jitendriyo'marAvatyAM sa prApnoti pulomajAm । asamAptakratuSatA vasantyatra mahIBujaH । jyotizwomAdiBiryAgErye yajantyapi te dvijAH । tulApuruzadAnAdi mahAdAnAni zoqaSa । ye yacCantyamalAtmAnastelaBante'marAvatIm । aklIvavAdinovIrAH saMgrAmezvapalAyinaH । viSrAntAvIraSayane te'tra tizWanti BUBujaH ityaddeSAt samAKyAtA mahendranagarIsTitiH । yAyajUkAvasantyatra yajYavidyAviSAradAH” 10 a॰ । “atiTistvindralokeSaH” iti manunA atiTiparicaryyABirapi tatprAptiruktA । evaM rAjasUyayajYenApi tatprAptiH BA॰ sa॰ uktA । SakralokAdayo'pyatra
m: इन्द्र—लोक m. Indra's world
Svarga or paradise, ŚBr.; Mn.; R. &c.
इन्द्र—लोकेश m. the lord of Indra's world i.e. Indra
a guest (as conferring paradise on his host).

s: klI, (indrARAM indranIlavarRakeSAnAM luptaM lopo yasmAt .) keSarogaviSezaH । wAka iti BAzA । tasya lakzaRam । “romakUpAnugaM pittaM vAtena saha mUrcCitam । pracyAvayati romARi tataH SlezmA saSoRitaH ॥ ruRadDi romakUpAMstu tato'nyezAmasamBavaH । tadindraluptaM KAlatyaM rujyeti ca viBAvyate” ॥ iti nidAnam ॥ KAlatyaM rujyeti ca tasya paryyAyakaTanam । taTAca BojaH । “tadindraluptamityAhuH KallIM rujyAYca kecana” । kArttikastvAha । “indralUptaM SmaSruRi Bavati KAlatyaM Siroruhezveva rujyA savedaneti Agamastatra nAsti” ॥ iti tawwIkA ॥ aTendraluptasya cikitsA । “tiktapawolIpatrasvarasErGfzwA SamaM yAti । cirakAlajApi rujyA niyataM divasatrayeREva ॥ gokzurastilapuzpARi tulyaYca maDusarpizaH । SiraH pralepitaM tena keSEH samupacIyate ॥ hastidantamasIM kftvA CAgIdugDarasAYjanaH । lomAnyanena jAyante lepAt pARitalezvapi ॥ yazwIndIvaramfdvIkAtElAjyakzIralepanEH । indraluptaM SamaM yAti keSA syuSca GanA dfQAH ॥ jAtIkaraYjavaruRakaravIrAgnipAcitam । tElamaByaYjanAdDanti indraluptaM na saMSayaH ॥ snuhIpayaH payo'rkasya lANgalImArkavo vizam । ajAmUtraM sagomUtraM rattikA sendravAruRI ॥ sidDArTakastIkzRaganDA samyageBirvipAcitam । tElaM Bavati niyamAt KAlityavyADinASanam ॥ snuhIdugDAditElam” । iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ (“keSaGnasya cikitsAntu SwaRu hArIta ! sAmpratam । rUkzaM sapARquraM vAtAt pittAdraktaM sadAhakam ॥ kaPAnvitaM Bavet snigDaM raktAtpAkaM vrajanti tat । sannipAtena sadfSaM jAyate sarvvalakzaRam” ॥ asya cikitsA yaTA ॥ * ॥ “guqena surasA SuRWI mAtuluNgarasena tu । keSaGne vAtasamBUte DAvanaYca praSasyate ॥ 1 ॥ triPalAYca vacAM SuRWIM guqenApi prapezitam । DAvanaM kaPasamBUte cendralupte praSasyate ॥ 2 ॥ pEttike ca hitaM dugDaM navanItAnvitantaTA । sitASivAPalaM yazwI pEttike DAvanaM matam ॥ 3 ॥ BfNgarAjarasaM grAhyaM SfNgaverarasantaTA । sOvIrakarasenApi tilAn pizwvA pralepanam ॥ paScAt kAryyaM pUruzeRa snAnamuzRena vAriRA । DavArjjunakadambasya SirIzamapi rohitam ॥ kvATamezAM SirodadrUn SamayedindraluptakaB । kurUvakasya puzpeRa japAyAH kusumena ca ॥ Gfzwasya cendralaptasya kftameva nivAraRam । pEttikAni ca liNgAni dfzwvA dugDena DAvanam ॥ SItalAni pradeyAni pEttikena viDIyate” ॥ “DustUrapatrARi ca mAgaDInAM niSA viSAlAgfhaDUmakuzWam । Gftena yuktaYca jalena pizwaM SiraHpralepe kzatavAraRaM syAt ॥ pitte kfte dozayute ca roge pawolapatraM picumarddakaM vA । taTAmalakyA Palameva pizwvA Gftena KaRqena pralepanaYca ॥ nivAryyate mastakajaM kzataYca SirorttisaNGAn vinihanti cEtat । gajendradantasya masIM gfhItvA pralepanaM vA navanItakena ॥ tilArkaBallAtakadagDamAzakzArasya lepo nabanItakena । sarpasya kzArasya taTA prayogaH KallAwake keSacayaM karoti” ॥ iti hArItaH ॥ “tejo'nilAdyEH sahakeSaBUmim dagDvASu kuryyAt Kalatinnarasya” ॥ * ॥ cikitsA yaTA carake । “KAlatye palite valyAM harillomni ca SoDitam । nasyEstElEH SirovaktapralepEScApyupAcaret ॥ sidDaM vidArIganDAdyErjIvanIyEraTApi ca । nasyaM syAdaRutElaM vA KAlatyapalitApaham” ॥)
puM, (indrARAM indranIlavat keSAnAM luptaM nASo yasmAt .) keSanASakarogaH । tatparyyAyaH । indraluptakaH 2 keSaGnaH 3 । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: na॰ indra indravarRRonIlaH keSo luptoyasmAt । keSanASake (wAka) KyAte rogaBede । tannidAnAdi “romakUpAnugaM raktaM pittena saha mUrcCitam । pracyAvayati romARi tataH SlezmA saSoRitaH । ruRadDi romakUpAstu tato'nyezA sasamBavaH । tadindraluptaM KAlatyaM rujyeti ca viBAvyate” nidA॰ uktam । nidAnawIkAkftA tu indraluptaM SmaSruRi Bavati । KAlatyaM Siroruhezva va rujyA savedaneti tezAM Beda uktaH । vA kap । indraluptakaM tatrEvArTe ।
m: इन्द्र—लुप्त, m. n. or इन्द्र—लुप्तक, n. morbid baldness of the head; loss of beard.

s: klI, (indralupta + svArTe kan .) indraluptarogaH । iti BUriprayogo jawADarahemacandrO ca ॥

k.v: व्याधिभेदा विद्रधिः स्त्री ज्वरमेहभगन्दराः। श्लीपदं पादवल्मीकं केशघ्नस्त्विन्द्रलुप्तकः। अश्मरी मूत्रकृच्छ्रं स्यात्पूर्वे शुक्रावधेस्त्रिषु॥

m: इन्द्र—मादन mfn. animating or delighting Indra, RV. vii, 92, 4.
इन्द्र—मार्गा f. N. of a river, R.

v: pu॰ indralokaprAptyarTomArgaH । vadarIpAcanasannikfzwasTe tIrTaBede । “vadarIpAcanaM gacCedvasizWasyASramaM gataH” ityupakramya “indramArgaM samAsAdya tIrTasevI narADipaH! । ahorAtropavAsena Sakraloke mahIyate” BA॰ va॰ 83 a॰ । tacca jalamayaM tIryyam “devikAmindramArgaYca svargavindu vigAhya ca । saptagaNge trigaNge ca indramArge ca tarpayan” BA॰ va॰ 25 a॰ tatra avagAhanatarpaRokteH ।
m: इन्द्र—मार्ग m. N. of a Tīrtha, MBh.
इन्द्र—मघ-श्री f. N. of a Gandharvī, Kāraṇḍ.

v: pu॰ indrasya tatpUjArTomaKaH । varzAdO SakratozArTe yajYaBede । sa ca maKaHnandAdiBiH pravarttitaH kfzRena nivarttitaSca tatra tatkaraRe nandeBa heturuktaH BA॰ 10 ska॰ 23 a॰ “parjanyo BagavAnindro meGAstasyAtmamUrttayaH te'Bivarzanti BUtAnAM proRanaM jIvanaM payaH । taM tAta! vayamanye ca vArmucAM patimISvaram । dravyEstadretasAsidDEryajante kratuBirnarAH tacCezeRopajIvanti trivargaPala hetave । puMsAM puruzakArARAM parjjanyaH PalaBAvanaH” iti nandenokte kfzRena tanmaKanivAraRena govardDanamaKasya pravarttanaM kftam tadapitatrEvoktaM yaTA “satvaM rajastamEti sTityutpattyantahetavaH । rajasotpadyate viSvamanyonyaM viviDaM jagat । rajasA noditAmeGA varzantyambUni sarvvataH prajAstereva sidDyanti kiM mahendraH karivyati na naH purojanapadA na grAmA na gfhA vayam । vanOkasastAta! nityaM vanaSElanivAsinaH । tasmAdgavAM brAhmaRAnAmadreScAraByatAM maKaH । yEndramaKasamBarAstErayaM sADyatAM maKaH” । BAga॰ 10 ska॰ 24 a॰ । aDikaM govardDanaDaraSabde vakzyate । “mayA te'kAri maGavan! maKaBaNgo'nugfhRatA । madanusmftayonityaM mattasyendraSriyA BfSamiti” 27 a॰ ।
m: इन्द्र—मख m. a sacrifice to Indra.
इन्द्र—मद m. a disease to which fish and leeches are liable, Suśr.

v: pu॰ indrasya santozArTomahaH । indrasantozArTe varzAdO karttavye utsavaBede । indrasya mahoyatra । varzASaratkAlayoH । indrotsava SakrotsavAdayo'pyuBayatra ।
m: इन्द्र—मह m. a festival in honour of Indra, MBh.; Hariv. &c.

s: puM, (indramahaM kAmayate iti । indramaha + kAma + ukaY .) kukkuraH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: pu॰ indramahe varzAdikAle kAmukaH kAma yitA । kukvure varzAdAbeva tezAM vyavAyaDarmmolokaprasidDaH ।
m: इन्द्र—मह—कामुक m. a dog, L.
इन्द्र—मह—कर्मन् m. a dog, L.
इन्द्र—महोत्सव m. a great festival in honour of Indra.
इन्द्र—मन्त्रिन् m. N. of Bṛhaspati (the planet Jupiter) Comm. on VarBṛS.
इन्द्र—मेदिन् (इन्द्र˚), mfn. one whose friend or ally is Indra, AV. v, 20, 8.

s: puM, (indravat nIlaH .) marakatamaRiH । iti hemacandraH ॥ pAnnA iti BAzA । (asya parIkzA yaTA, cintAmaRiDftavacanam । “kzIramaDye kzipet nIraM kzIraYcet nIlatAM vrajet । indranIlamitiKyAtaM tadAhi ratnakovidEH” ॥ “kvacit praBAlepiBirindranIlErmuktAmayI yazwirivAnuvidDA” ॥ iti raGuvaMSe । 13 । 54 । yaTA, BAvaprakASaH ॥ aTa indranIlagomedayornAmAni । “nIlantaTendranIlaYca gomedaH pItaratnakam” .)
v: pu॰ indrEva nIlaH SyAmaH । (pAnnA) iti KyAte jarakatamatamaRO” tallakzaRamuktaM ratnaparIkzAyAm “kzIramaDye kzipennIlaM kzIraYcennIlatAM vrajet । indranIla iti KyAtaH sarvvaratnottamottamaH” । asya nIlavarRatvaM ca raGO gaNgAyamunAsaMgame yamunAsAdfSyAya varRRitam yaTA “kacit praBAlepimirindranIlErmuktAmayI yazwirivAnuvidDA anyatra mAlA sitapaNkajAnAmindIvarErutKacitAntareva” “prApyendranIlaM kimutonmayUKam” raGuH । “ekaM muktAguRamiva BuvaH sTUlamaDyendranIlam” “peSalErindranIlEH” meGadU॰ । asya hiMhaladvIpasamBavatve mahAnIlasaMjYA yaTA hi “mahAmahAnIlaSilAruvaH puraH” mAGavyAKyAyAM mallinATena “siMhahAsyAkarodBUtA mahAnIlAstu te smftAH” iti agastyavAkyaM pramARatayopanyastam । “vApIzvantarmahAnIladalAsu” mAGaH vAKyAne tena taTevoktam ।
m: इन्द्र—नील m. a sapphire, Ragh.; Megh.; Śiś.; BhP.

s: puM, (indranIla + svArTe kan .) marakatamaRiH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: इन्द्र—नील—क m. an emerald, L.

v: na॰ । indrasvAmikaM nakzatram । 1 jyezWAnakzatre tasya tatsvAmikatvAt taTAtvam । aSlezASabde 499 pfzWe nakzatreSvarA uktAH । indranAmakaM nakzatram । 2 PalgunInakzatre ca । PalgunInakzatrasya indranAmakatvamAha Sata॰ brA॰ 2, 1, 2, 11 । yaTA “PalgunIzvagnI AdaDIta । etA vA indranakzatraM yatPalgunyo'pyasya pratinAmnyo'rjjunohavE nAmendroyadasya guhyaM nAmArjjunyovEnAmEtAstvA etat parokzamAcakzate Palgunya iti ko'hyetasyA guhyaM nAma grahItum indrovE yajamAnastattasya evEtannakzatre agnI ADatte”
m: इन्द्र—नक्षत्र n. Indra's lunar mansion
N. of Phalgunī, ŚBr. ii, 1, 2, 11.
इन्द्र—पाल m. N. of a king.
इन्द्र—पालित m. ‘protected by Indra’, N. of a king, VP.
also of a Vaiśya Comm. on Pāṇ. viii, 2, 83.
इन्द्र—पान mfn. worthy to be Indra's drink, RV.
इन्द्र—पातम mfn. most worthy to be drunk by Indra, RV. ix, 99, 3.
इन्द्र—पीत (इन्द्र˚), mfn. drunk by Indra, RV.; KātyŚr.
इन्द्र—पद m. = इन्द्र-ता.
इन्द्र—पर्णी f. N. of a plant (perhaps Methonica Superba), Suśr.

v: strI indra iva lIlaM parRRamasyAH jAtitvAt NIy । ozaDiBede । “kAlAnusAryyagurukocamuYjArAsnASIta SivendraparRRyaH” suSru॰ ।

m: इन्द्र—पर्वत m. N. of a mountain, MBh.

v: pu॰ indranAmakaH parvvataH । 1 mahendraparvvate indravarRaH parvvataH । 2 nIlavarRe giriBede “vEdehasTastu kOnteya indraparvvatavAsinaH । kirAtAnAmaDipatInajayat sapta pARqavaH” BA॰ sa॰ 28 a॰ ।

strI 6 ta॰ । 1 pulomajAyAM SacyAm । “utAhamasmivIriRIndrapatnI marut saKA viSvasmAdindra uttaraH” f॰ 1086, 9 । indrasya patiH pAlayitrI “sapUrvvAcceti” pA॰ NIp nuk ca । 2 indrapAlayitrIzu iqAdizu trisfsu devIzu ca “hotA yakzattisrodevIrna BezajaM trayastriDAtavo'pasa iqAsarasvatI mAratI mahIH । indrapatnIrhavizmatIH” yaju॰ 28, 8 । “indrapatnIH indrasya pAlayitryaH, vedadI॰ SacI tu Sukragrahasya pratyaDidevatA “SavI pratyaDidEvatamiti SukraDyAnam । vivAhAdO pUjanIyazoqaSamAtfkAntargatA ca ।
m: इन्द्र—पत्नी f. the wife of Indra, RV.; VS.

s: klI, (indrasya praharaRam .) indrasyAstram । vajram । iti halAyuDaH ॥
v: na॰ 6 ta॰ । vajrAstre tacca daDIcomunerasTinirmmitaM tatkaTa aSani Sabde 464 pf॰ uktA ।
m: इन्द्र—प्रहरण n. Indra's weapon, the thunderbolt, L.
इन्द्र—प्रमद m. N. of a man.

v: pu॰ fgvedADyayanArTaM vyAsena Sizyatvena gfhItasya pElasya fzeH SizyaBede । “praTamaM vyAsaSizyastu pEla fgvedapAdapam । indrapramataye prAdAt viBajya paYca saMhitAH” agni pu॰ । “ekEkAM saMhitAM brahman ekEkasmE dadO viBuH । pElAya saMhitAmAdyAM vahvfcAKyAmuvAca ha” । ityupakramya “pElaH svasaMhitAmUce indrapramataye muniH” BAga॰ 12 ska॰ 6 a॰
m: इन्द्र—प्रमति m. a pupil of Paila and author of some verses of the Ṛg-veda, RAnukr.; BhP.; VP.; AgP.

s: klI, (indrasya indrakIlasya prasTam iva .) rAjayuDizWiranirmmitanagaram । aDunA dillI iti KyAtam । (yaTA, mahABArate 1 । 208 । 28 । “tataH puRye Sive deSe SAntiM kftvA mahAraTAH । nagaraM yApayAmAsurdvEpAyanapurogamAH ॥ sAgarapratirUpABiH pariKABiralaNkftaM” ॥ “tattripizwapasaNkASaM indraprasTaM vyarocata । meGavfndamivAkASe vidDaM vidyutsamAvftam” ॥)
v: na॰ indrasya indrasTAnaBeroH prasTEva (dillIti) KyAte pure । “indraprasTagamastAvat kAri mA santu cedayaH” mAGaH । “indraprasTaM kfkaprasTaM mAkandaM vAraRAvatam । iti me caturogrAmAnkaYcidekaYca paYcamam” veRI॰ KARqavaprasTe yuDizWireRa yadaBinavapuraM nirmpitaM tadindraprasTatayA viKyAtam । tadetat BArate A॰ 206 a॰ varRRitam । “pratigfhyatutadGAkyaM nfpa sarvvepraRamya ca । pratasTire tato GoraM vanaM tanmanujarzaBAH । ardDaM rAjyasya samprApya KARqavaprasTamAviSan । tataste pARqavAstatra gatvA kfzRapurogamAH । maRqayAYcakrire tadvE puraM svarggavadacyutAH । tataH puRye Sive deSe SAntiM kftvA mahAraTAH । nagaraM mApamAsurdvEpAyanapurogamAH । sAgarapatirUpABiH pariKABiralaNkftam । prAkAreRa ca sampannaM divamAvftya tizWatA । pARqurABraprakASena somaraSminiBena ca । SuSuBe tatpuraSrezWaM nAgErBogavatI yaTA । dvipakzagaruqapraKyErdvArEH sODESca SoBitam । guptamaBracayapraKyE rgopurErmmandaropamEH । viviDErapi nirvvidyE SastropetEH susavftEH । SaktiBiScAvftaM tadDi dvijihvEriva pannagEH । talpEScAByAsikEryuktaM SuSuBe yoGarakzitam । tIkzRANkuSaSataGnIBiryantrajAlESca SoBitam । virocamAnaM viviDEH pARqarErBavanottamEH । tattripizwapasaNkASamindraprasTaM vyarocata । meGavfndamivAkASe vidDaM vidyutsaBAgfham । tatra ramye Sive deSe kOravasya niveSanam । SuSuBe DanasamyUrRaM DanADyakzakzayopamam” “evaM samprApya rAjyantadindraprasTaM tapoDana!” tatra 207 a॰ ।
m: इन्द्र—प्रस्थ n. ‘Indra's place’, N. of a city (now called Delhi, the residence of the Pāṇḍavas), MBh.
इन्द्र—प्रसूत (इन्द्र˚), mfn. caused or impelled by Indra, RV. x, 66, 2.
इन्द्र—प्रयाण n. the sinking down of Indra's banner, Viṣṇ.
इन्द्र—पुरोगम mfn. preceded or led on by Indra, having Indra as leader.
इन्द्र—पुरोहिता f. the asterism Puṣya, L.

v: strI indraH putro yasyAH । adityAm । tasyA indrajananItvAt taTAtvam ।
m: इन्द्र—पुत्रा f. ‘having Indra as son’, Indra's mother, AV. iii, 10, 13.

s: strI, (indranIlavat puzpaM yasyAH .) lANgalikIvfkzaH । iti ratnamAlA ॥ vizalANgalA iti KyAtA । (lANgalikISabde'syA vivaraRaM jYeyaM .)

v: strI indra iva nIlaM puzpamasyAH jAtitvAt NIp । (vizalANgalA) jANgalIvfkze । “arkAlarkakaraYjadvayanAgadantImayUrakaBArgIrAsnendrapuzpIkzudraSvetetyAdi” suSrutaH । vA kapi atEttve indrapuzpikApyatra

m: इन्द्र—पुष्प, m., इन्द्र—पुष्पा, इन्द्र—पुष्पिका, and इन्द्र—पुष्पी, f. the medicinal plant Methonica Superba, Bhpr.; Suśr.; L.

s: strI, (indrapuzpEva । kan .) kalikArI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ vizalANgalA iti BAzA ।

m: इन्द्र—राज m. N. of various kings, Inscr.

इन्द्र—साह्व n. = इन्द्र-यव, q.v.
इन्द्र—सारथि (इन्द्र˚), mfn. Indra's companion N. of Vāyu, RV. iv, 46, 2 and 48, 2.

s: puM, caturddaSamanuH । asmin manvantare vfhadBAnuravatAraH । SucirindraH । pavitracAkzuzAdayo devAH । agnibAhuSuciSudDamAgaDAdyAH saptarzayaH । urugamBIrabraDnAdyA manuputrA Bavizyanti ॥ iti SrIBAgavatam ॥ (ayaM hi BOtyanAmnA caAKyAtaH । yaTA, vizRupurARe 3 । 2 । “BOtyaScaturdaSaScAtra mEtreya BavitA manuH । SucirindraH suragaRAstatra paYca SfRuzva tAn । 40 । cAkzuzASca pavitrASca kanizWA BrAjirastaTA । vayovfdDASca vE devAH saptarzInapi me SfRu । 41 । agnibAhuH SuciH Sukro mAgaDo'gnIDra eva ca । yuktastaTAjitaScAnyo manuputtrAnataH SfRu । 42 । urugamBIrabraDnAdyA manostasya sutA nfpAH” । 43 । mArkaRqeyapuMrARe'pi 100 aDyAye uktarUpeRa varRitam । aDunA tu saptamamanvantarasyAzwAviMSatitamaM yagaM .)
v: pu॰ caturddaSe manO । “manurvA indrasAvarRiScaturddaSamaezyati । urugambaravraDnAdyA indrasAvarRivIryyajAH । pavitrAScAkzuzA devAH Sucirindro Bavizyati । agni bAhuH SuciH Sukro mAnDAtAdyAstapasvinaH । satrAyaRasya tanayo vfhadBAnustadA hariH । vinatAyAM mahArAja! kriyAtantUn vitAyitA” BA॰ 8 ska॰ 13 a॰ । harivaMSe tu “BUtyAYcotpAdito devyAM BOtyonAma ruceHsutaH” iti BOtyotpatti muktvA “caturddaSe'Ta paryAye BOtyasyEvAntare manoH । agnIDnaH kaSyapaScEva pOlastyogArgavastaTA । BArgavahyaScignibahu SucirANgirasastaTA । yuktaScEva taTAtreyaH SukrovAsizWa eva ca । ajitaH pOlahaScEva mAnyAH saptarzayaSca te iti” coktvA “devatAnAM gaRAH proktAH paYca vE BaratarzaBa । taraNgamIru rvapraSca taraAnugraeva ca । aBimAnI pravIRaSca SrutaH saMkrandanastaTA । tejasvI saraRaScEva BItyasyete manoH sutA । BOtyasyEvADikAre tu pUrRekalpastu pUryyate” । agnipu॰ ca “manuScaturddaSo BOtyaH Sucirindro Bavizyati । cAkzuzAdyAH suragaRA agnibAhvAdayo dvijAH । catudarSasya BOtyasya putrA urumuKA manoH” ityuktaM tena nAmaBedaviroDaH kalpaBedAt samADeyaH ।
m: इन्द्र—सावर्णि m. N. of the fourteenth Manu, BhP.
इन्द्र—स्थान n. the place of Indra's banner, VarYogay.

v: na॰ indradevatAkaM sUktam । fgvedAntargate sUktaBede tacca “indraM viSvA avIvfDan” ityAdi ekAdaSarccam । f॰ 1 ma॰ 11 sUktam etacca tattatkarmaRi indrastutyarTaM paWanIyaM taTA dvArapAlena tulAdAnAdO maRqapasya pUrvadiSi pAWyaYca “SrIsUktaM pAvamAnaYca somasUktaM sumaNgalam । SAntyaDyAyaYcendrasUktaM rakzoGnaM ceti bahvfcO । pUrvaM dvAraM samASritya paWetAmiti niScayaH” viDAnapAri॰ pu॰ । tacca sUktaM tulAdAnAdipadDatO 92 pfzWe'smABiH pradarSitam ।

m: इन्द्र—सूनु m. ‘the son of Indra’, N. of the monkey-king Vālin.
इन्द्र—सभा f. ‘Indra's court’, N. of a drama
इन्द्र—सख (इन्द्र-), m. a friend of Indra, Suparṇ.
इन्द्र—सखि (इन्द्र˚), mf(आ)n. one whose ally or companion is Indra, RV.; AV.
इन्द्र—संधा f. connexion or alliance with Indra, AV. xi, 10, 9.
इन्द्र—संजय n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
इन्द्र—सरस्वती m. N. of an author, Cat.
इन्द्र—सव m. a particular Soma sacrifice, MaitrS.; Kāṭh.

v: strI 6 ta॰ । indrasya 1 senAyAm । 2 baDnasyamAtari mOdgalyasya jyezWa putrapatnyAm । “mOdgalyasya suto jyezWo brahmarziH sumahAyaSAH । indrasenA yatogarBaM vaDrAKyaM pratyapadyata” hari॰ 32 a॰ “nArAyaRIvendrasenA baBUva vaSyA nityaM mudgalasyAjamIMQa” BA॰ va॰ 113 a॰ ।
m: इन्द्र—सेना (आ), f. Indra's army, RV. x, 102, 2
N. of a goddess
of several women

v: pu॰ indrasenAM nayati nI--kvip 6 ta॰ । Sakrasya senApatO kArttikeye tatkaTA । kArtiyena parAjitenendreRa kArttikAya indratvapadaM dAtumIhamAnena saha tasya uktipratyukti varRanena tena tatsenApatyamamaNgIkftametat BA॰ va॰ 28 a॰ varRRita yaTA “SakrOvAca Bavasvendro mahAvAho! sarvvezAM naH suKAvahaH । aBizicyasvacEvAdya prAptarUpo'si sattama! । SADi tvameva trElokyamavyagrovijaye rataH । ahante kiNkaraH Sakrona mamendratvamIpsitam । balaM tavAdButaM vIra! tvaM devAnAmarIn jahi । avajYAsyanti mAM lokA vIryyeRa tava vismitAH । indratvaM tu sTitaM vIre! balahInaM parAjitam । AvayoSca miToBedaM prayayizyantyatandritAH । Bedite ca tvayi viBo! lokodvEDamupEzyati । dviDABUtezu lokezu niScitezvA vayostadA । vigrahaH maMpravartteta BUtaBedAnmahAvala! । tatra tvaM mAM raRe tAta! yaTASradDaMvijezyasi । tasmAdindro BavAneva BavitA mA vicAraya । skanda uvAca । tvameva rAjA Badrante trElokyasya mamEva ca । karomi kiYcate Sakra । SAsanaM tadbravIhi me । indra uvAca । ahamindro BavizyAmi tava vAkyAnmahAbala! । yadi satyamidaM vAkyaM niScayAdBAzitaM tvayA । yadi vA SAsanaM skanda! karttumicCasi me SfRu । aBizicyasva devAnAM senApatye mahAbala । skanda uvAca । dAnavAnAM vinASAya senApatye'BiziYca mAm” । BA॰ va॰ 228 a॰ SakrasenApatiSakrasenADipAdayo'pyatra । “SakrasenApatiH skandaH” pu॰

pu॰ indrasya senA iva senA yasya । 1 nfpaBede sa ca parikzitaH putraBedaH “parikzito'Bavat putrAH sarve DarmArTakovidAH kakzasenograsenO ca citrasenaSca vIryyavAn । indrasenaH suzeRaSca BImasenaSca nAmataH” BA॰ A॰ 94 a॰ ayaYca prasidDAt parikzitaH prAcInaH kuruvaSyaeva indrABaSabde vivftiH । yuDizWirasya 2 BftyaBede । “indrasenAdayaScEva BftyAH pari caturddaSa । raTEranuyayuH SIGrEH striya AdAya sarvaSaH” BA॰ va॰ 1 a॰ “indraseno viSokaSca puruScArjjunasAraTiH । annAdyAharaRe yuktAH santu matpriyakAriRaH” BA॰ sa॰ 32 a॰
m: इन्द्र—सेन m. N. of several men
N. of a Nāga
of a mountain, BhP.
इन्द्र—सेन—द्वितीय mfn. attended by Indra-sena.
इन्द्र—सिंह m. N. of a poet.

v: pu॰ atirAtrANge yAgaBede sa ca kAtyA॰ 24 4, 6, । atirAtropakrameRa “indrastomo viSvajitA” viSvajitaH sTAne indrastomaH kAryyaH” karka॰ । pUrvvoktamupakramya tatprakArAdi tatra darSitam । ayaYcarAjYA kAryyaH “indrastomo rAjayajYaH” “sahasraM dakziRA” kAtyA॰ 22, 11, 15, 16, sa ca ukTasADyaH “ukTyaH” kAtyA॰ 12, 11, 17 ukteH ।

pu॰ indraHstUyate'tra । indrastutyaDikaraRe ukTya yajYe dvitIyAhe “indrastudukTyo dvitIyamaharBavati । indrovE sarvvedevAH sarvvezAM devAnAmAptyO tasyEndrAgrahA BabantyOndryaH purorucaH sarvvamEndramasaditi” Sata॰, 13, 7, 1, 4, ayamukTyasADyaH tadupakramaeva kAtyA॰ 21, 1, 4, । “traya ukTyA agnizwutindrastut sUryyastut” ityaBiDAnAt ।
m: इन्द्र—स्तुत् or इन्द्र—स्तोम, m. ‘praise of Indra’; N. of particular hymns to Indra in certain ceremonies, ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.; KātyŚr.
इन्द्र—सुपर्ण m. du. Indra and Suparṇa, Suparṇ.

v: strI indrasyAtmanaH sureva priyA । (rAKAlasasA) indravAruRyAm rAjani॰ “vArttAkuSimbIndrasurApawoletyAdi” suSru॰ । “guqucIndrasurA kfzRA kuzWasarzapanAgarEH । tElameBiH SanEH pakvaM surAsnAdirasAplutam” suSru॰ ।
m: इन्द्र—सुरा f. a species of Colocynth, Suśr.

m: इन्द्र—सुरस m. a shrub (the leaves of which are used in discutient applications), Vitex Negundo, L.

of Arjuna
of Jayanta, L.

इन्द्र—ता f. power and dignity of Indra.

इन्द्र—तेजस् n. Indra's thunderbolt, BhP.

m: इन्द्र—वारुणिका or इन्द्र—वारुणी, f. Colocynth, a wild bitter gourd, Cucumis Colocynthis
इन्द्र—वाततम mfn. much desired by Indra, RV. x, 6, 6.
इन्द्र—वायु m. du. Indra and Vāyu, AV. iii, 20, 6; RV.
इन्द्र—वैदूर्य n. a kind of precious stone, Suśr.
इन्द्र—वैरिन् m. Indra's enemy, a Daitya, L.

v: na॰ indrasya kuwajasya vIjam । indrayave । “cavyendravIjaM triPalAsarpirmAsarasAmbuBiH” suSru॰ ।
m: इन्द्र—वीज See -बीज.
इन्द्र—वीरुध् f. Indra's snare, PārGṛ.

v: strI “syAdindrabaMSA tatajErasaMyutEH” vftta॰ ra॰ ukte dvAdaSAkzarapAdake varRavfttaBede ।

इन्द्र—वह् (in strong cases ˚वाह्) mfn. conveying Indra (said of his horses), RV.

इन्द्र—वज्र n. Indra's thunderbolt, VarBṛS.
N. of a Sāman

इन्द्र—वन n. N. of a place.
इन्द्र—वर्मन् m. N. of a warrior.

m: इन्द्र—वस्ति m. the calf (of the leg), Suśr.
इन्द्र—वत् (इन्द्र˚), or in some cases (RV. iv, 27, 4 and x, 101, 1) इन्द्रा-वत् mfn. associated with or accompanied by Indra, RV.; AV. v, 3, 3; AitBr.

s: strI, (indreRa indriyajanitadozeRa vfdDA । yadvA indraH SrezWo'pi vfdDaH kfSo Bavati yasyAH .) vraRarogaviSezaH । tasya lakzaRam । “padmakarRikavanmaDye piqakABiH samAcitAm । indravfdDAntu tAM vidyAdvAtapittotTitAM Bizak” ॥ iti nidAnam ॥ tasyAScikitsA । vivfttAmfndravfdDAYca garddaBIM jAlagarddaBam । pEttikasya visarpasya kriyayA sADayet Bizak । pAke tu SozayedAjyapakvErmaDuraBezajEH” ॥ iti BAbaprakASaH ॥ (“yA padmakarRikAkArA piwikA piwikAnvitA । sAvidDA vAtapittAByAM tAByAmeva ca garddaBI” ॥)
v: strI “aTAtaH kzudrarogAn vyAKyAsyAma ityupakramya । “balmIkamindravfdDetyAdi viBajya” । “padmapuzkaravanmaDye piqkABiH samAcitAm । indravfdDAntu tAM vidyAdvAtapittotTitAM Bizak” suSrutoktalakzaRe kzudrarogaBede । “vivftAmindravfdDAYca garddaBIM jAlagarhaBam । irivillAM ganGanAmnIM kakzAM visPowakAMstaTA । pittajasya visarpasya kriyayA sADayet Bizak” iti suSru॰

इन्द्र—˚वृक्षीय [gaṇa उत्करादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 90], belonging to or coming from the above.

the number five as symbolical of the five senses. (In addition to the five organs of perception, बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि or ज्ञानेन्द्रियाणि, i.e. eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin, the Hindūs enumerate five organs of action, कर्मेन्द्रियाणि i.e. larynx, hand, foot, anus, and parts of generation; between these ten organs and the soul or आत्मन् stands मनस् or mind, considered as an eleventh organ; in the Vedānta, मनस्, बुद्धि, अहंकार, and चित्त form the four inner or internal organs, अन्तर्-इन्द्रियाणि, so that according to this reckoning the organs are fourteen in number, each being presided over by its own ruler or नियन्तृ; thus, the eye by the Sun, the ear by the Quarters of the world, the nose by the two Aśvins, the tongue by Pracetas, the skin by the Wind, the voice by Fire, the hand by Indra, the foot by Viṣṇu, the anus by Mitra, the parts of generation by Prajāpati, manas by the Moon, buddhi by Brahman, ahaṃkāra by Śiva, citta by Viṣṇu as Acyuta; in the Nyāya philosophy each organ is connected with its own peculiar element, the nose with the Earth, the tongue with Water, the eye with Light or Fire, the skin with Air, the ear with Ether; the Jainas divide the whole creation into five sections, according to the number of organs attributed to each being.)

k.v: गोचरा इन्द्रियार्थाश्च हृषीकं विषयीन्द्रियम्. कर्मेन्द्रियं तु पाय्वादि मनोनेत्रादि धीन्द्रियम्.।

tri॰ indriyaM boDayati svapAnasADyavEkalya buDa + Ric + lyu । svapAnasADyavEkalyaboDake madye madyapAne hi indriyamAtrasya svasvakAryyavyApArApAwavakaraRAt AtmavIryyaM tAni boDayatIti tasya taTAtvam । “sarvaM pittakara madyam” ityupakramya “pAke laGu vidAhyuzRa tIkzRamindriyaboDanam” । “kazAyamaDuraM madyaM suganDIndriyaboDanam” । “vAtaGno maDuraprAyohfdya indriyaboDanaH” suSru॰ ।
m: इन्द्रिय—बोधन and इन्द्रिय—बोधिन्, mfn. arousing the bodily powers, sharpening the senses, Suśr. n. any excitement of sense, an object of perception, a stimulus, &c.
इन्द्रिय—बुद्धि f. perception by the senses, the exercise of any sense, the faculty of any organ.

v: pu॰ indriyasya gocaraH vizayaH । SabdAdizu vizayezu te hi pratiniyatamekEkasyendriyasya grAhyA yaTA Srotrasya grAhyaH SabdaH, tvagindriyasya sparSastadviSizwadravyaYca, cakzuzorUpaM tadASrayadravyaYca, rasanAyAH rasaH, GrARasya ganDa ityAdi । evamanyAnyapi nyAyAdimate tattadindriyagrAhyA RyuktAni yaTA “GrARasya RocaroganDo ganDatvAdirapi smftaH । taTA rasorasajYAyAstaTA Sabdo'pi ca SruteH” । AdipadAt suraBidu ganDatvayorgrahaRam । taTA rasatvamADuryyAdisahitaH । evaM SabdatvatAratvamandatvAdisahitaH “udBUtarUpaM nayanasya gocarodravyARi tadvanti pfTaktva saMKye । viBAgasaMyIgaparAparatvasnehadravyatvaM parimARayuktam । kriyAM jAtiM yogyavfttiM samavAyaM ca tAdfSam । gfhRAti cakzuH sambanDAdAlokodBUtarUpayoH । udBUtasparSavaddravyaM gocaraH so'pi ca tvacaH । rUpAnyaccakzuzo yogyaM rUpamatrApi kAraRam” BAzA॰ so'pi udBUtasparSo'pi cakArAt tadvfttisparSatvamfdutvakaWinatvAdi grAhyam । ete ca bAhyendriyARAM vizayAH । tezAM mate manasa indriyatvAt tadgrAhyAstatrEvoktA yaTA “manogrAhyaM suKaM duHKamicCA dvezomatiH kftiH” evaM suKatvaduHKatvAdikamapi

v: pu॰ indriyARAM nigrahaH yaTezwaM pravfttAnAM svasvavizayeByaH nivarttanena niroDaH । indiyARAM yaTezwaM pravfttAnAM svasvavizayezu 1 prasaNganivAraRe । sa ca sarvvavarRasADAraRa DarmmaH “DftiH kzamA dayA'steyaM SOcamindriyanigrahaH । DIrvidyA satyamakroDo daSakaM DarmmalakzaRam” manuH । indriyanigrahaH apratizidDe'pi vizaye'natiprasaNgaH” ekA॰ ta॰ raGu॰ । 2 yogasADanANge SrotrAdInAM jYAnendriyARAM vAgAdInAM ca karRRendriyARAM svasva vyApArezu aniyojanarUpe roDane ca । sarvezAmaniroDe yogasidDyaBAvoBaNgyA gItAyAmuktaH” । “indriyARAntu sarvvezAM yadyekaM caratIndriyam । tadasya harati prajYAM dfteH pAtrAdivodakam” manasonigrahAdevAnyezAM nigraho Bavati nAnyaTA “indriyARAM hi caratAM yanmano'nuviDIyate । tadasya harati prajYAM vAyurnAvamivAmBasi” gItAyAM taTokteH । manonigrahopAyaSca “asaMSayaM mahAbAho! manodurnigrahaM calam । aByAsena tu kOnteya! vErAgyeRa ca gfhyate” gItokteH aByAsavErAgyErUpaH । yaTecCamindriyaprasaNge pApamapyuktam “vihitasyAnanuzWAnAt ninditasya ca sevanAt । anigrahAccendriyARAM naraH patanamfcCati” yA॰ smf॰ । indriyajayopyatra indriyajaye ca SOcameva hetuH । yaTA ha pAta॰ sUtraBAzyayoH “SOcAt svANgajugupsA parErasasargaH” “satvaSudDisOmanasyEkAgryendriyajayAtmadaSanAni ca” sU॰ “SuceH satvaSudDistataH sOmanasyaM tata EkAgryaM tata indriyayastataScAtmadaSanayogyatvam budDisattvasya BavatIti” BA॰ eza ca bAhya upAyaH । AByantara upAyasta trEvoktaH । “grahaRasvarUpAsmitAnvayArTavattvasaMyamAdindriyajayaH” pA॰ sU॰ “sAmAnyaviSezAtmA SabdAdirgrAhyaH tezvindriyARAM vfttirgrahaRaM (1 rUpam) na ca tatsAmAnyamAtragrahaRAkAram kaTamanAlocitaH savizayaviSeza indriyeRa manasAnuvyasIyeteti! svarUpaM punaH prakASAtmanobudDisattvasya sAmAnyaviSezayorayutasidDAvayavaBedAnugataH samUho dravyamindriyam । (2 rUpam) tezAM tftIyaM rUpam । asmitAlakzaRo'haNkAraH tasya sAmAnyasyendriyARi viSezAH । caturTaM rUpaM vyavasAyAtmakAH prakASakriyAsTitiSIlA guRAH, yezAmindriyARi sAhaNkArARi pariRAmaH । paYcamaM rUpaM guRezuyadanugataM puruzArTavattvamiti paYcasvetezuindriyarUpezu yaTAkramaM saMyamaH tatra tatra jayaM katvA paYcarUpajayAdindriyajayaH prAdurBavati yoginaH” BAzyam tatPalamapi tatroktam । “tato manojavitvaM vikaraRaBAvaH praDAnajayaSca” pA॰ sU॰ “kAyasya manobadanuttamagatilABo manojavitvam । videhAnAm (dehAnapekzARAm) indriyARAmaBipretadeSakAlavizayApekzI vfttilABaH atItAnAgatadUrasTabAhyArTavizayaSca vfttilABo vikaraRaBAvaH । sarvaprakftivikAravaSitvaM praDAnaBAvaH ityetAstisraH sidDayo maDupratIkA ucyante etASca karaRa paYcakarUpajayAdaDigamyante” BA॰ etAsAYca bAhyasidDInAM pAramparyyeRa satvapuruzAnyatamAKyAtireva tu muKyaM Palamiti tatrEva prasidDam ।

v: pu॰ indriyasya svasvavizayEH saha sannikarzaH mambanDaBedaH । pratyakzasADane indriyasTa svasvavizayEH sambanDaBedarUpe pratyakzajanakavyApAre । sa ca nyAyamate zoQA yaTA “vizayendriyasaMbanDovyApAraH so'pi zadDiDaH । dravyagrahastu saMyogAt saMyuktasamavAyataH dravyezu samavetAnAM, taTA tatsamavAyataH tatrApi samavetAnAM, Sabdasya samavAyataH । tadvfttInAM samavetasamavAyena tu grahaH । viSezaRatayA tadvadaBAvAnAM graho Bavet” BAzA॰ । taTA ca dravyasya pratyakze indriyasaMyogaH kAraRam dravyasamavetaguRakarmmajAtItAM pratyakze indriyasaMyuktasamavAyaH । dravyasamavetasamavetAnAM guRatvakarmmatvAdInAM pratyakze indriyasaMyuktasamavetasamavAyaH । Savdasya pratyakze SrotrasamavAyaH SabdavfttiSabdatvAdeH, SrotrasamavetasamavAyaH kAraRam । “aBAvapratyakze samabAyapratyakze ca indriyasaMyuktasvarUpasambanDaviSezaRatA hetuH । vESazikamate tu samavAyasya na pratyakzam । atra yadyapi viSezaRatA nAnAviDA taTA hi BUtalAdO GawABAvaH saMyuktaviSezaRatayA gfhyate saMKyAdO rUpAdyaBAvaH saMyuktasamavetaviSezaRatayA, saMKyAtvAdO rUpAdyaBAvaH sayuktasamavevatamavetaviSezaRatayA । SabdABAvaH kevalaSrotrAvacCinnaviSezaRatayA । kAdO KatvAdyaBAvaH SrotrAvacCinnasamavetaviSezaRatayA । evaM katvAvacCinnABAve KatvABAvAdikaM viSezaRaviSezaRatayA । evaM GawABAvAdO pawAdyaBAvaH saMyuktaviSepaRaviSezaRatayA । evamanyadapyUhyam taTApi viSezaRatAtvarUpeREkEva sA gaRyate anyaTA zIQA sannikarza iti prAcAM pravAdo vyAhanyateti” muktA॰ । indriya saMyogAdayo'pyatra

s: puM, (unatti amftaDArayA BuvaM klinnAM karoti iti । unda + u + Adericca .) candraH । (“dilIpa iti rAjendarinduH kzIraniDAviva” । iti raGuH । 1 । 12 .) karpUraH । ityamaraH ॥ (candrasamasaMKyaH ekasaMKyAyuktaH । mfgaSirAnakzatram ॥ “divArkakiraRErjazwaM spazwamindukarErniSi” । iti vEdyakadravyaguRaH ॥)
v: pu॰ unatti candrikayA BuvaM klinnAM karoti unda--u Adericca । 1 candre, “dilIpa iti rAjendurinduH kzIraniDAviva” raGuH “tasyAH prasannendumuKaprasAdam” mahodaDeH pUrEvendudarSanAt” raGuH “rAmasyendoriva SriyaH” raGuH “na narmmasAcivyamakAri nenda nA” “kziptAivendoH saruco'Divelam” mAGaH “karErindorantaSCurita ivasaMBinnamukulaH” veRI॰ amftakarEH sakalatApanivAraRenAsya indutvam । 2 vastAt sTitaH yaTAha sU॰ si॰ । “mandAmarejyaBUputra sUryyaSuktendajendavaH । pariBramantyaDo'DasTAH” । tasTa kakzAmAnamuktam । si॰ Si॰ yaTA “sArdDAdrigomanu surAbDimitArkakakzA (4331497 । 30) cAndrI sahasra guRitA jinarAmasaMKyA” (324000) । etanmitayojanAni indukakzAmAnam । anukzaRa gacCatAM grahARAM rASicakre izwasamaye kIdfSAMSe'vasTitiriti jYAnAya aharSaRena tasya sTuwI karaRaprakArAdi tatrEva darSitaM yaTA । “aBrezviBANka gajakuYjarago'NkapakzAH (259889850) kakzAM gfRanti gaRakA BagaRasya cemAm । “atra ravikakzAto BakakzA zazwi guRA, evaM BakakzAyAH zazwyaMsoravikakzA” prami॰ “kalpodBavEH kzitidinErgaganasya kakzA maktA Baveddinagati rgaganecarasya । “pAdonago'kzaGftiBUmitayojanAni (1185840) KewA vrajantyanudinaM nijavartmanIme” si॰ Si॰ “yadi kudinO kakzAmitayojanAni gacCanti tadEkena kimiti PalaM dinagatiyojanAni । tAni ca sTulatvena tAvat pAdonago'kzaDftiBUmitAni syuH” prami॰ । grahAnayanamAha । “ahargaRAt kvakzinavANkaniGnAt (9921) navenduvedezuhutASa (35419) labDyA । ahargahaRo go'kzaDftIndu (11 859) niGno vivarjitaH syurgatayojanAni” KayAsvayA tAni pfTak ca kakzayA hftAni vA syurBagaRAdikAgrahAH” si॰ Si॰ । “ahargaRe BUnetranavananda 9921 guRe navaSaSiSrutivARAgniBiH 35411 Bakte yallabDaM tena bivarjjitaH kAryyaH । kaH? । nandendriyaDftIndu 118 guRo'hargaRaH । evaM gatayojanAni syuH teByaH pfTakpfTakv KayA svayA kakzayA BAjiteByo BagaRAdikA grahAlaByante atropapattiH । dinagatiyojanErahargaRe gatayojanAni BavantIti sunamam । atra suKArTaM go'kzaDftInduBiH 11859 saMpUrRErahargaRo guRitaH । so'Diko jAtaH । yadaDikaM tacCoDyam । tasyADikasya jYAnArTamupAyaH । paramo'hargaRaH kudinatulyaH । tena guRakena guRyaH । evaM go'kzaDftInduniGraH san KakakzAto'Diko Bavati । tasmAt KakakzAM viSoDya SezeRAnupAtaH । yadi kudinatulyenAhargaRenEtAvadaDikaM Bavati tadizwenAhargaRena kimiti । atra kudinAnAM tasya Sezasya ca paYcapaYcayugavedErayutaguRitE 445 50000 rapavarte kfte sati SezasTAne kvakzinavANkA utpannAH kudinasTAne nandenduvedezahutASAH । eva trErASikena yallaByate tena sTUlagatiguRite'hargaRe varjite gatayojanAni Bavanti । sarvezAM grahARAM tAnyeva gatestulyatvAt । aTa grahArTamanupAtaH । yadi kakzAtulyErgatayojanEreko BagaRastadEBiH kimiti PalaM gataBagaRAdyAH sarve grahA BavantItyupapannam” pramitA॰ । “grahasya kakzEva hi tuNgapAtayoHpfTak ca kalpyAtra tadIyasidDaye । arkasya kakzEva sitajYayoH sA jYeyA tayorAnayanArTameva । ukte tayorye calatuNgakakze tatrEva tO ca Bramato'rkagatyA” si॰ Si॰ “atroccasya pAtasya ca yA kakzA gacCati sA tayorAnayanArTameva kalpyA । anyaTA yA grahasya kakzA sEva tayorapi । yato grahakakzAyA uccapradeSasyoccavyapadeSaH । yatra ca vimaRqalena saha saMpAtastasya pradeSasya pAtasaMjYeti gole samyak pratipAditamasti । taTA buDaSukrayoratra ye arkakakzAtulye kakze AgacCataste tayorAna tatra Sukro BramatItyarTaH” prami॰ । atra gaganakakzA ca kalpArhagaRaH । yaTAhAryyaBawwaH । “yoyatra Bramati KagastadvfttaM Bavati tasya kakzAKyam । ambarakakzA kalpAhargaRanAmA BaveddyugatiH” । svasvaPakzAyAM sTitAnAmapi grahARAM nIcoccasTAnasTitivaSataH pariGiBedAdikaM BavatIti grahaSabde vakzyate । atra buDaSukrakakzayoH ravikakzAtulyatvaM yaduktaM tanmaDyakakzayA PalAnayanArTam । SrIpatinA tu grahAntarARAM kakzAmitiruktA yaTA । “azwyaNkazaRmanugajAH (8146916) kzitinandanasya, jYasyeSadanta kftaKendumitATa (1043211) jEvI । rUpASvinAga yugaSElaguRenduvARAH (51374821) SiSucAndrAyaRaM vratam । azwAvazwO samaSnIyAt piRqAnmaDyadine gate । mAsenASnan havizyasya candrasyEti salokatAm” manuH । etat paYcaviDaM cAndrAyaRam pipIlikAtanumaDyam, yavamaDyaM, yaticAndrAyaRam, sarvatomuKaM SiSusaMjYaYca । yaTAha jAvAlaH “zipIlikAyavamaDyaM yaticAndrAyaRantaTA । cAndrAyaRantaTA jYeyaM caturTaM sarvatomuKam । paYcamaM SiSusaMjYaYca tulyaM puRyaPalodayam” । kfzRapratipadamAraBya mAsamekaM yadA kriyate tadA pipIlikAmaDyaM Bavati, SuklapratipadAramBe yavamaDyamuBayatrAmAvAsyAyAmaBojanaM kfzRapratipadi caturddaSagrAsaBojanAramBe hrAsakrameRa caturddaSyAmekagrAsaH amAvAsyAyaHmaBojanam evaM prApnoti taTA ca vasizWaH । “mAsasya kfzRapakzAdO grAsAnadyAccaturddaSa” । nanvevaM krameRa paYcaviMSatyuttaraM grAsaSatadvayaM syAt na catvAriMSadgrAsADikaM Satadvayam tacca yAjYavalkyenoktam” “yaTA kaTaYcit piRqAnAYcatvAriMSacCatadvayamiti” । “yaTA kaTaYcit piRqAnAM tisro'SItIH samAhitaH” iti manunApyuktam । ucyate saMyamadivase pOrRamAsyAm amAvAsyAyAM vA paYcadaSagrAsaBojanena saMKyApUraRasamBavAt aTa vA paYcadaSyAdikamevedaM vratam na pratipadAdikaM caturddaSyAmeva vratasaNkalpaH । yaTAha gotamaH pOrRRamAsyAM paYcadaSa grAsAn BuktvE kEkApacayenAparapakzamaSnIyAt amAvAsyAyAmupozya ekEkopacayena pUrbapakzam, viparItamekezAm” SaNKaliKitO “amAvasyAyAM vratopAyanaM yavamaDyam amAvasyAyAM paYcadaSa piRqAnaSnIyAt” upAyanamAramBaH । yuktaYcedam avAsyAyAmapi paYcadaSakalAtmakasya candramasaH sUryyapravizwatvAt tata ekEkakalAnirgamasya pratipadAdizu vfdDiSabda vAcyatvAt । jAvAlaH “ekEkaM vardDayegrAsaM Sukle kfzRe ca hrAsayet । amAvasyAM na BuYjIta yavamaDyaYcaran dvijaH । ekEkaM hrAsayedgrAsaM kfzRe Sukle ca vardDayet । pOrRRamAsyAM na BuYjIta pipIlitanumaDyamam” । atra kalpataruvyAKyAnam । ekEkaM hrAsayediti kfzRapratipadi paYcadaSagrAsamAraBya ekEkApacayenAmAvAsyAyAmekogrAsaH tadanantaraM Suklapratimadi dvO grAsAvevaM vfdDikrameRa caturddasyAM paYcadaSa grAsAH sampadyante pOrRRamAsyAYcopavAsa iti” pipolikA tanumaDyaM cAndrAyaRam” । fzicAndrAyaRamAha yamaH “trIMstrIn piRqAn samaSnIyAt niyatAtmA dfQavrataH । havizyAnnasya vE mAsamfzicAndrAyaRaM smftam” । atra catvAriMSacCatadvayasaMKyA nAsti । grAsaparimARamAha parASaraH “kukkuwARqapramARantu yAvadvA praviSenmuKam । evaM grAsaM vijAnIyAcCudDyarTaM kAyaSoDanam” । sakala candrAyaRa eva caturddaSyAmupavAsaM kftvA'paradine paYcadaSyAM saMyamaH kAryyaH । yaTA bODAyanaH “SuklAM caturddaSImupavaset kfzRacaturddaSIM vA keSaSmaSrunaKalomAni vApayitvA” ityAdyaBiDAya “tiTinakzatrAdihomaM pratyahamuktavAn” vistaraBayAnna liKitam । atra sAmAnyavrataDarmmaH karttavyaH । viSezamAha yamaH “ArdravAsAScaret kfcCraM snAtvA vastraM na pIqayet । aNgulyagrasTitaM grAsaM gAyatryA cABimantrayet । BakzayitvA upaspfSya punarevABimantrayet । AyasaM tEjasaM pAtraM cakrotpannaM vivarjjayet । asurARAM hi tat pAtraM pAnapAtramacakrajam” acakrajaM kulAlacakrAnizpannam । apare DarmmA bODAyanAdizu drazwavyAH । tena ekatriMSaddinasADyaM cAndrAyaRavratam” । yA॰ smf॰ । “tiTivfdDyA caret piRqAn Sukle SiKyaRqasammitAn । ekEkaM hrAsayet kfzRe piRqaM cAndrAyaRaM caran । yaTAkaTaYcit piRqAnAM catvAriMSacCatadvayam । mAsenEvopaBuYjIta cAndrAyaRamaTAparam । kuryyAttrizavaRa snAyI kfcCraM cAndrAyaRaM taTA । anAdizweyu pApezu SudDiScAndrAyaRena tu । DarmmArTaM yaScaredetaccandrasyEti salokatAm” atra (240) grAsasaMKyoktermaDye nopavAsa (240) BojyagrAsasaMKyA । taTAca samarTAsamarTaBedena anayorvyavasToti sidDAntaH ।
